findings.summary: The Add to Cart button's accessible name inserts the product name between visible words, so speech-input users may be unable to invoke it by its visible label.
findings.fix: Keep the visible label contiguous in the accessible name, such as `Add to Cart: ${product.name}`.
findings.evidence: Visible: “Add to Cart”; aria-label: `Add ${product.name} to cart`

findings.summary: The quantity controls put their group name on generic divs, which do not expose that name, leaving the quantity controls and value without a programmatic group label.
findings.fix: Use a `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>` naming the product quantity around each quantity control and its output.

findings.summary: When URL preview validation fails, the input is marked invalid but its error is not associated with it, so users revisiting the field may not learn why it is invalid.
findings.fix: Set `aria-describedby="feature-image-error"` on the URL input whenever an error is present.

passed: Dialog labeling, semantics, focus handling and keyboard dismissal passed the inspected checks.
notes: The Navbar trigger implementation was outside the requested scope, so its element semantics could not be verified.
